provenance: Provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]
serves: RULES.md DECL-P4-10 item 2 (family FE detector), FROZEN before any title-strip (E1/E2) number

E1.eligible: p4-tiles-b e1/manifest.json: valid >= 0.5 and frac outside 1.129 um volume < 0.5 (60 tiles; p4-highz rule/code)

C.eligible: valid >= 0.5 and frac outside < 0.5 from m2b/manifest.json (64 tiles; p4-highz rule/code)

C2.eligible_rule: grid T 8343 from (0,0); tile eligible if >= 50 % of its blocks are valid (block valid = >= 50 % of its px valid)
C2.role: known-text control (carbon ink) for E2; same 2.4 um pipeline as E2 (the 2.4 um trace of w028-037)

calibration_rules.sample: 2 % of control chunk positions, rng 20260926 (calib.py); control only
calibration_rules.side: recto surface layer on + side iff the sheet-core mean exceeds the gap mean (both controls: +1, sheet mass on the - side)
calibration_rules.v_air: min of the depth-profile mean over slices c+4..c+27 (gap side)
calibration_rules.v_pap: max of the depth-profile mean over slices c-12..c-4 (sheet core)
calibration_rules.B_lo: round(v_pap): band starts at the papyrus-core mean
calibration_rules.B_hi: min(254, round(v_air + 10.9 delta)): full voxel of standard ochre ink in the optimistic mu regime; caps denser grains (magnetite, Hg/Pb)
calibration_rules.note: voxel noise sd ~36-43 grey levels vs delta ~12-15: a single voxel carries almost no FE evidence; the detector relies on integration over ~1e5 px per stroke bar

detector.per_px: e = mean_S(x) - mean_I(x); px valid iff mesh-valid (E1/C: tifxyz rule of p4-highz) and every voxel of the fetch range F is nonzero
detector.bands_slices: S = recto surface layer 0..+20 um (gap side), I = sheet interior -20..-7 um, D = deep null -41..-22 um (f_in only); see families.*.bands (half-open [lo, hi))
detector.block: 8x8 px at 2.258 um (18.06 um) for E1/C; 4x4 px at 4.8 um (19.2 um) for E2/C2; block value = sum over valid px, with the valid count

matched_filter.response: r = (valid-weighted mean e over bar) - (valid-weighted mean e over flanks); max over orientations

detector.normalisation: z = r / sigma0; sigma0 = 1.4826 MAD of r over all valid positions of the eligible control tiles of the same family (C for E1, C2 for E2)
detector.tile_score: max z over bar centres whose block centre lies in the tile (tile + 2.5 mm margin of data used)
detector.rot90_null: same score on np.rot90 of the tile(+margin) block maps; the 4-orientation kernel set is closed under 90 deg, so this is an implementation check more than an independent null (disclosed)
detector.in_sheet_fraction: f_in = mean S-band excess / (mean S-band excess + mean D-band excess) over the argmax bar footprint; depth-uniform material gives ~0.5

threshold.theta: per family: numpy.percentile(control tile z  UNION  control tile z_rot90, 99) (DECL-P4-10 item 4)
threshold.hotspot: non-labelled-adjacent title-strip tile with z > theta AND f_in >= 0.8

injection.locations: >= 10 control (C / C2) and >= 10 title-strip (E1 / E2) per family; random eligible tile and chunk-aligned origin, rng seeds 101 (C), 202 (E1), 303 (C2), 404 (E2); patch accepted iff >= 90 % mesh-valid (E1/C, mask only) and >= 90 % nonzero columns
injection.letters: 15 Greek capitals (A, Delta, E, H, K, Lambda, M, N, Pi, Sigma, T, Gamma, Omega, Xi, Z) as polylines; height U[2,4] mm, stroke U[0.3,0.6] mm, rotation {0,90,180,270} + U[-10,10] deg
injection.layer: from the mesh plane outward (+ side), per-slice occupancy min(1, max(0, t/um_z - k)) for slice centre+k
injection.value_model: v' = v + blur(o (V_paint - v)), V_paint = v_air + R (v_pap - v_air); only voxels > 0; clip 1..255; round
injection.detection: z_letter = max z over bar centres within the letter bbox dilated by 0.5 mm; detected iff z_letter > theta; also reported with f_in >= 0.8
injection.false_positive: baseline (no plant) z over the same window > theta, at control and title locations; control tile FP by leave-one-out threshold; rot-90 null
injection.verdict_rule: sensitivity < 0.8 at 5 um in the primary regime -> 'insensitive' at the plausible thickness (DECL-P4-10 item 3); detection limit = smallest thickness with sensitivity >= 0.8 per regime

smoke_test: inject.py run once on control C (1 location, dummy theta/sigma0) to check the code runs; no E1/E2 byte read before this file was pushed
